description: Declared methodology, taxonomy and contract transitions. tools/validate.py classifies a semantic difference as expected only when an entry here matches it exactly and applies: the current source contains introduced_by and the retained package's producing commit does not. A match without from values must be previously_absent, which is verified from the retained result itself. Never add an entry only because current code produced a difference; record the rule or code path responsible.

transitions.reason: Assessment decisions are scoped to tenant technical readiness. A confirmed critical tenant condition is reported as 'Tenant remediation required' instead of 'Not ready for pilot'.

Pilot planning is outside the tenant readiness scope. The ADOPTION.BASELINE control is no longer assessed: it and the findings it listed are no longer reported, and its remaining planning rows become Reference context.
transitions.rule: Core/assessment_result.py (assessment questions exclude ADOPTION.BASELINE; adoption planning rows become Reference); Core/control_reviews.py; docs/TENANT_READINESS_SCOPE.md

transitions.reason: Application consent is aggregated from structured component results. An unresolved required component makes the control Not established; another component's evidence never fills the gap.
Findings record a ReadinessTreatment. Results produced before this field existed have no value to compare.
Findings record a FindingClass and an ActionLane, and results carry a consolidated customer action plan. Results produced before these existed have no value to compare.
A finding classified as Reference inventory or Adoption context never keeps an action status; its status becomes Insight and the original status is retained as OriginalStatus.
